Zu fett: Gemischschraube in kleinen Schr: Too rich: turn the mixture screw in in small steps (⅛ turn); if that is not enough, drop one pilot jet size.
Zu mager: Gemischschraube in kleinen Sch: Too lean: turn the mixture screw out in small steps (⅛ turn); if that is not enough, go one pilot jet size up. Also check for air leaks (intake manifold, gaskets).
Zu fett: Düsennadel-Clip um eine Positio: Too rich: move the needle clip up one position (needle drops), or fit a needle with a leaner taper.
Zu mager: Düsennadel-Clip um eine Positi: Too lean: move the needle clip down one position (needle rises), or fit a needle with a richer taper. If it surges badly, check the slide cutaway as well.
Zu fett: Düsennadel-Clip um eine Positio: Too rich: move the needle clip up one position (needle drops). Each clip position is worth roughly 2–4 % less fuel.
Zu mager: Düsennadel-Clip um eine Positi: Too lean: move the needle clip down one position (needle rises). Each clip position is worth roughly 2–4 % more fuel.
Too rich: drop one main jet size. Each jet size is usually worth 2–4 % less fuel. Sort this range out first, then work downwards.
Too lean: go one main jet size up. Each jet size is usually worth 2–4 % more fuel. Thin air (altitude/heat) leans the mixture — note the ambient conditions.

_comment_blocks: Entries below contain markup and are replaced as whole fragments, because English word order does not follow the German split around inline <strong> tags.
Luft strömt nur durch den schmalen Spalt: Air passes only through the narrow gap beneath the closed throttle slide. Fuel comes solely from the pilot jet and is metered finely by the mixture screw.
Der <strong>Gasschieber</strong> beginnt: The throttle slide starts to lift. Its cutaway (chamfer) and the start of the needle taper set the mixture — this is where the pilot circuit stops having an effect and the main jet has not taken over yet.
Schieber zur Hälfte geöffnet. Der <stron: Slide half open. The mid-range of the jet needle controls the opening in the needle jet. The needle's clip position has the strongest effect on the mixture here.
Schieber ganz oben, Nadel vollständig au: Slide fully raised, needle pulled clear of the needle jet. Now the main jet alone limits fuel flow. Pick the main jet size for full-throttle tuning.
